consultations.section: Workmate noun and Working life topic label
consultations.finding: The workmate meaning includes people in the same business or profession. Same-profession colleagues need not share one employer. No regional spelling alternative is shown for the selected headword.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: employee
consultations.section: Paid-worker noun and Working life topic label
consultations.finding: The ordinary noun concerns someone paid to work for another person or organization. This lexical description is not a jurisdictional test of employment status. The inspected headword has no regional spelling alternative.
consultations.limits: Selected passages consulted by an AI author. No source examples, full entries, exercises, images or audio are acquired. consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: employer
consultations.section: Hiring person/company noun and Business/Working life labels
consultations.finding: The ordinary noun can name a person or a company paying people for work. Both kinds of referent belong in the definition. Nothing in this consultation determines legal employer status or a duty to provide training.

consultations.section: Work/research oversight noun; Working life and Jobs labels
consultations.finding: The noun refers to a person supervising people or activities. Workplace and research uses are both shown. The selected topic labels are C1; the unrelated footer B2 belongs to another word and supplies no downlevel evidence.

consultations.section: Sense 1, running an organization or part of one; Jobs/Business/Shopping labels
consultations.finding: The work-role noun covers responsibility for a whole business or organizational unit. Entertainment representation and sports management have separate uses. The selected workplace sense supports retaining A2 provisionally. Software compounds require their own readings.

consultations.finding: The selected sense is people cooperating on a job. The noun heading permits singular or plural verb agreement. No separate CEFR label was observed for this working-group sense. Sports A1 and animal-team C2 labels must not be transferred to it.

consultations.finding: The noun covers a specialized section of an organization, including business, government, university and store settings. The abbreviation Dept is listed, but an abbreviation is not automatically an accepted spelling for this full-word exercise.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: customer
consultations.finding: The buyer may be a person or an organization and may buy services as well as goods. This prevents a false rule that customers buy only things while clients receive all services. A1 evidence is below the present course-schema floor.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: client
consultations.section: Professional-advice/services sense 1 and separate computing sense 2
consultations.finding: The selected noun concerns users of professional advice or services and can include organizational customers. An ongoing relationship is not necessary. The professional-services label is B1; the separate computing C2 label does not apply.
consultations.limits: Selected passages consulted by an AI author. No source examples, full entries, exercises, images or audio are acquired. consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: visitor
consultations.section: Physical-visit sense 1 and separate website-use sense 2
consultations.finding: The physical sense concerns someone visiting a person or place; the website-user meaning is separately listed. The physical entry does not justify an absolute rule that visitors can never normally work or live at the location. Its observed Holidays label is A1.

consultations.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: supervise
consultations.finding: The verb includes being in charge of people or work and checking that work is performed correctly. This supports a clear monitoring definition for supervisor without granting universal authority, legal powers or a particular safe procedure.

consultations.title: Collins English Dictionary / COBUILD: supervisor
consultations.section: COBUILD countable noun; British and American entries
consultations.finding: The ordinary countable noun concerns someone overseeing people or activities, especially workers or students. Supervisors is shown as its plural. British and American entries support the work role; specialized educational or public-office uses are separate. No usable CEFR label was established; frequency bands are not CEFR.
